name: Gods Creation
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of all things, as affirmed in Genesis 1:1 and John 1:3, where all creation is made through Him and for Him. The heavens and the earth declare His glory and handiwork (Psalms 19:1), making visible His eternal power and divine nature (Romans 1:20). Humanity, uniquely created in God's image, is entrusted with dominion over the earth and its creatures (Genesis 1:26), highlighting the responsibility of stewardship within God's creation. Colossians 1:16 further emphasizes that all things, both visible and invisible, were created by and for Christ, grounding creation firmly in His authority.
